question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Prepaer'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word here is: **'Prepaer'**
 
• The correct spelling is **"Prepare".**
 
• **It means to **make something or someone ready for some activity, purpose, use, etc. (तैयार करना).

Therefore, the **correct spelling** is:* 'Prepare'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's the explanation for the other options:
 
 
• **"Mushy" - **This word is spelled correctly. It means like mush in consistency or firmness.(नरम और गीला)
 
• **"Busiest" - **This word is also spelled correctly. It's the superlative form of "busy," meaning the most occupied or engaged(सबसे व्यस्त).
 
• **"Matter" -** This word is spelled correctly. "Matter" has various meanings, it can refer to a subject or topic of concern or it can refer to physical substance in general, as distinct from mind and spirit.(मुद्दा)
